subject: [Invite] Encord Physical AI Leaders Dinner @ Taverna 02/26
text:
Hi [NAME],

Our Co-Founders will be hosting an intimate Physical AI roundtable dinner
for customers & CxOs and we'd love for you to join if you're available.

We've booked a private dining room at Taverna in Palo Alto on Wednesday
February 26th 6:30-9:30pm, capping attendance to ~25 people.

Attendees include Co-Founders, CEO's, CTOs & Heads of ML etc. from leading
VC-backed scale-ups such as Archetype AI, Physical Intelligence, Ambi
Robotics, Cobot, The Bot Company etc. We will also be joined by a few of
our investors, including Next47 and CRV.

In case you're not familiar with Encord - we're an SF-based data
development platform (recently raised our Series B) built to help computer
vision teams get better models to market, faster. For context, we're
working with many leaders in your space doing similarly great things to
Corvus around warehouse automation etc.

Thought it was a good opportunity to get connected - would you be
interested in joining? I can send over an invite if so.

subject: [Invite] Boston AI / CV Leaders Community
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Over the last two years, we've hosted intimate roundtable dinners for AI / CV Execs in London, Paris, New York, & SF (see positive feedback here: [LINK]) - & now we're looking to start building a similar community in Boston. 

My team and I are going to be in town Mon 24th - Tues 25th Feb & we'd love to grab a coffee to get your feedback on what event formats could work well / connect more broadly & swap notes on what we're seeing in the space.

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we're a ~5 years old AI scale up, with 100+ employees & offices in London & San Francisco. 

Would you be interested in having a quick coffee?

Open to learning more?
